note: Connectors are INTEGRATION-plane workers. None of them may mark work verified, approve its own execution, declare tests or runtime PASS, suppress findings, create a checkpoint, or override the watchdog or a human gate. aegis-state.cjs refuses to load any entry whose plane is not INTEGRATION, and a test proves that refusal. Default health is UNKNOWN: a connector that has never been probed is UNKNOWN, never HEALTHY, because an optimistic default is how an outage stays invisible.
